name: library_policy
knowledge_text: The university library is open from 8 AM to 10 PM on weekdays. Students can borrow up to 5 books at the same time. Books can be borrowed for 14 days. Late returns are charged 2 dollars per day. The library is closed on Sundays.

name: hotel_policy
knowledge_text: Hotel check-in begins at 3 PM. Guests must check out by 11 AM. Breakfast is included only with Premium rooms. Reservations can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before arrival. Pets are not allowed in the hotel.

name: software_subscription_policy
knowledge_text: The Basic plan costs 10 dollars per month. The Pro plan costs 25 dollars per month. Priority customer support is available only on the Pro plan. Users can cancel their subscription at any time. Account data is retained for 30 days after cancellation. Annual subscriptions receive a 15 percent discount.
